en: A sepia-toned image of a single-storey wooden house with a steep, shingled gable roof and two brick chimneys. The facade has several rectangular windows and a central wooden door, above which there appears to be a small sign or plaque. The house adjoins a tall wooden fence on a brick base, partially shaded by a large tree to the right. The street in front is empty except for a small figure near the left edge. The image has wide margins, giving it the look of an early 20th-century printed postcard.
